title: rbcL reference database (~330 bp) – marine algae and seagrasses (rbcL_marine_algae)
creator: morgane.durand@mnhn.fr
marker: rbcL (RuBisCO large subunit, plastid), ~330 bp fragment

parameters.marker: rbcL (RuBisCO large subunit, plastid), ~330 bp fragment
parameters.trim_long_amplicons: yes (amplicons > MAX_LEN re-cut at inner primer sites, else by alignment on normal amplicons, identity >= 0.85; log logs/09_long_trimmed.tsv)
parameters.excluded_taxa: (removed after import, after the final filters)
parameters.taxonomy_fix: yes (genus homonyms: BOLD phylum, then target groups + Ochrophyta;Bacillariophyta;Phaeophyceae; log logs/10_taxonomy_fix.tsv)
parameters.taxonomy_reference: Adl et al. (2019) J Eukaryot Microbiol 66: 4-119
parameters.bold_groups: Rhodophyta Chlorophyta Ochrophyta Haptophyta Zosteraceae Posidoniaceae Cymodoceaceae
parameters.ncbi_groups: Rhodophyta Chlorophyta Phaeophyceae Bacillariophyta Haptophyta Cryptophyceae Pelagophyceae Dictyochophyceae Chrysophyceae Raphidophyceae Xanthophyceae Eustigmatophyceae Bolidophyceae Glaucocystophyceae Zosteraceae Posidoniaceae Cymodoceaceae
parameters.ncbi_query: <group>[Organism] AND (rbcL[Gene] OR "ribulose-1,5-bisphosphate carboxylase/oxygenase large subunit"[All Fields] OR "ribulose bisphosphate carboxylase large chain"[All Fields]) AND 200:300000[SLEN]
parameters.ncbi_query_unannotated: <group>[Organism] AND (chloroplast[filter] OR plastid[filter]) AND (UNVERIFIED[Title] OR genome[Title] OR "chloroplast sequence"[Title] OR "plastid sequence"[Title]) AND 200:300000[SLEN]

software.script: 1.4.1 (2026-10-28, shared CRABS/taxo and CRABS/reference_database_creator; 1.4: from crabs_coi.sh 1.8 + taxonomy fix of 1.7.2 + long-amplicon re-cut of 1.7.3)
